title: Senior Customer Support Engineer
description:
About Fyxer

Since launching in May 2024 we've grown to $30 million in ARR. Fyxer is building an AI executive assistant that handles emails, scheduling and follow-up, freeing people in client-facing roles to focus on their customers.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the hardest technical tickets in the business end to end, including the customer conversation, from first report through to resolution

  • Dogfood Fyxer’s own products, give feedback, and influence our roadmap

  • Establish blast radius before escalating, because one customer reporting something is a ticket and forty-seven accounts in the same broken state is an incident

  • Call bug, incident or user error correctly and quickly, and declare it when it's an incident

  • Write escalations Engineering can act on without a single follow-up question, and stay on them until they land

  • Spot patterns across Linear and the queue, raising a tracker before the fifth report of something becomes the tenth

  • Reduce the need for your own role through runbooks, saved queries, Parahelp knowledge, and hands-on upskilling of our senior agents

Here's the honest version of why this role exists. In one recent three-month window we escalated 47 tickets to Engineering and two of them were resolved. Engineering is capacity-constrained, and a third of what we sent them was correctly deprioritised. So this isn't a role that escalates better, it's one that resolves. You'll be backed by strong Customer Success and Product Engineering teams, and given read-only access to our codebase through Cursor, to our data through our internal tooling, and to our production logs to do it.

What Success Looks Like

  • You resolve a growing share of technical escalations without Engineering ever being involved

  • Your escalations are complete, so Engineer can act on them quickly

  • You use AI and you catch it when it's wrong, before it reaches a customer

  • You hold a customer's confidence while you investigate, rather than handing them back to someone else

  • Our senior agents are visibly more capable six months in than they are today, because of you

  • You're the person the team wants on the ticket because they trust your judgement.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in a technical support role within a SaaS or cloud-based company

  • API fluency: you can read an API reference, reason about authentication, and say what a 401 rather than a 500 tells you about where the fault sits

  • SQL you write yourself: given an unfamiliar schema you work out how the tables relate and write the join unaided

  • Comfortable in logs, following a request across services and working backwards from an error

  • Strong written communication, particularly to a customer who is unhappy

  • Experience with customer support tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, Jira, Linear, others

  • Startup-ready: adaptable, fast-moving, and hands-on

We're not asking for production engineering experience or a computer science degree. We care what you can do, not how you got there.

Location and other bits

  • Based in our Chancery Lane office in London, Monday to Thursday, with Fridays from home

  • Standard office hours

  • Benefits include: on-site gym, private medical, pension and lunch provided everyday

The Hiring Process

  1. Submit your CV (no need for a cover letter)

  2. We'll review it

  3. An initial call with someone from the hiring team to review your experience and motivation for joining (30 mins)

  4. A call with our Head of Customer Support on your experience and how you think technically (30 minutes)

  5. A live technical exercise (60 minutes)

  6. Meet more of the team (30 minutes)

For the exercise we'll give you access to a small example application, a database, an API and its logs, a couple of days ahead, along with three customer tickets. You don't need to solve anything in advance, and you're welcome to use whatever AI tooling you normally would, because that's how the job actually works. We'll be paying attention to how you check its answers.

Our Culture

Our culture is intentional. It stems from the fact we're in the race of our lives to reshape one of the largest AI opportunities that exist; email. There is only first or last.

We're going to win by:

  • An obsession around the fact that every second counts, we have to move fast with intensity and drive hard every day.

  • Never let it slide, be relentless in challenging yourself and others to strive for the best outcome.

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we'll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

Why we’re hiring

  • You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

  • Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.

Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all.   • Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.

Your future position

Join Kpler’s Chartering team as a Junior Market Data Analyst – Chartering and play a key role in ensuring the quality and accuracy of the data that powers our Chartering products.

Kpler’s Chartering products rely on accurate vessel, ownership and market data to help charterers, shipowners and brokers make informed commercial decisions. In this role, you will work hands-on with the datasets behind these products, investigating inconsistencies, validating information and helping improve data quality at scale.

Your work will span a range of chartering datasets, from vessel ownership and characteristics to fixtures, cargo orders, vessel positions and shipping zones. You will use SQL and Python to extract, transform and analyse data, build validation checks and investigate potential issues. 

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of data, asking why something doesn't look right and finding ways to identify and solve problems systematically. You will work closely with Product, Data, Research, Engineering and AI/ML teams, turning individual data issues into broader improvements across Kpler's datasets and products.

  • Help establish and track data-quality metrics, benchmarks and processes as Chartering datasets expand.

title: Head of Compliance and Risk (UK)
description:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency, a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

We are looking for GCP and AI Instructors to join our team of instructors. This role offers flexible, hybrid working arrangements. As part of our award-winning team, you will help support our customers and deliver high-quality instruction globally to some of the world’s largest brands.

We require an experienced Cloud professional with a passion for teaching. It may be that you are already a seasoned GCP instructor, or that you have a talent for sharing knowledge but are not yet a certified instructor. Any applicant must be extremely experienced with the creation of solutions using GCP technologies. Instructors could be asked to teach a range of topics from the comprehensive Google Cloud certification paths. Therefore, holding a wide range of certifications is essential. Please include detailed information on which certifications you currently hold upon application.

Beyond general cloud infrastructure, a strong understanding of AI-related topics is absolutely essential. You will lead courses across Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise Agent PlatformI, and GenAI architecture. If you have a passion for sharing knowledge, developing AI training curriculums, and presenting to enterprise clients, this is the perfect role for you.
Please note this will be a 12-month fixed-term contractual position

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver virtual classroom sessions globally. Flexibility is paramount; this is not a strict 9-5 role.

  • Instruct courses covering any topics from the Google Cloud certification paths, adapting to varying client needs.

  • Provide occasional face-to-face training to clients in your region, with potential opportunities for international travel to deliver overseas courses.

  • Google Cloud AI Curriculum Delivery: whilst not extensive, there may be some opportunity to help develop custom courseware and materials.

  • Take responsibility for keeping pace with the rapidly evolving GCP technology landscape, particularly in AI.

  • Maintain and grow your range of current valid GCP certifications.

Qualifications

  • What you’ll need:

    • Essential Certifications: A wide range of Google Cloud certifications is required to cover the diverse certification paths. (Please detail which you hold upon application).

    • A minimum of 5 years’ experience with Cloud Technologies.

    • Strong understanding of AI-related topics.

    • Comfortable presenting and delivering multiple-day-long training sessions both in the classroom and online.

    • Comfortable in training enterprise-level clients on how to develop or diversify their current skill set.

    • Clear communication of processes, strategies, and general requirements to both internal and external stakeholders.

    • Systems Operations experience, including deploying and managing applications, either on-premises or in a public cloud environment.

    Advantageous:

    • An excellent writer and communicator, comfortable speaking to advanced audiences, large groups, etc.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

  • Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport

  • A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative

  • Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel

  • Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months

  • Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board

  • The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model

  • Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step

  • Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture

  • Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue

  • International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages

  • Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup

Our culture and what we offer 🌍

We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🏥 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase

Benefits vary by country of employment - your recruiter will walk you through the specifics for your location.

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the global industry we serve. We welcome applications regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let it stop you - if you think you'd thrive here, we'd rather hear from you than not.

Join our Talent Pool

Not quite the right role, or the timing isn't right? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we'll be in touch when something fits: https://nivoda.net/talent-pool

title: Senior Talent Partner
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

Join Faculty as a Senior Talent Partner to lead end-to-end hiring across our high-growth organisation. You will own the recruitment lifecycle for both individual contributor and leadership positions across Applied AI within the commercial space and across our Central Functions.

Beyond filling roles, you will spearhead high-impact projects in employer branding, candidate experience and DE&I. This is a pivotal role for an ambitious professional ready to shape our talent strategy, engage elite passive candidates and ensure Faculty remains the employer of choice in the AI and technology market.

What you'll be doing:

  • Proactively sourcing high-caliber, diverse candidates using innovative techniques and tools to maximise direct hires and build robust talent pipelines.

  • Advising and coaching hiring managers on recruitment best practices, inclusive hiring techniques, and data-driven decision-making.

  • Working on strategic projects related to employer branding, early careers, and candidate experience to amplify Faculty’s presence in the market.

  • Managing the end-to-end recruitment journey, ensuring a fair and inclusive process that prioritises an exceptional experience for every applicant.

  • Collaborating across the business to understand evolving strategy and culture, acting as a brand ambassador at industry meet-ups and conferences.

  • Utilising market insights and data to continuously optimise hiring workflows, identifying trends, and recommending innovative solutions to recruitment challenges.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring significant experience in end-to-end recruitment from within the commercial and/or central functions space, ideally from within a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

  • You possess expert sourcing skills, with a proven ability to identify and engage passive, qualified talent using a broad range of modern tools and methodologies.

  • You are a skilled communicator who can adapt your style to influence senior stakeholders and persuasively articulate Faculty’s mission to candidates.

  • You demonstrate a deep commitment to DE&I, with a track record of successfully integrating inclusive practices into sourcing and selection activities.

  • You thrive on ownership and accountability, using data-driven insights to manage your time effectively and meet ambitious delivery goals.

  • You've demonstrated a clear understanding of how AI is shaping the hiring landscape and changing modern talent strategies.

  • You have a strong grasp of interview evaluation methods and employment compliance, combined with an entrepreneurial mindset that seeks to constantly "raise the bar."

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial Talent Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introductory interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins)

  3. Competency & Scenario based interview (60 mins)

  4. Final Interview with our Chief People Officer (30 mins)

#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

  • Unlimited Annual Leave Policy

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working

  • Sanctus Coaching

  • Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Senior Operational Finance Manager – 6 Month Fixed Term Contract
description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Finance Team 👋

At Trainline, our Finance team is the backbone of how we manage, govern, and grow the business responsibly. From transactional processing to financial controls and systems ownership, the team works across a broad range of disciplines to ensure Trainline operates with accuracy, integrity, and commercial rigour. This is a pivotal interim appointment within our operational finance function, sitting within a high-performing team and reporting directly to the Group Financial Controller.

As Interim Senior Operational Finance Manager, you will lead the teams responsible for Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Finance Systems, and our Cashbook function, driving operational excellence and embedding a continuous improvement mindset across the function. You will work closely with Finance leadership and Technology colleagues to strengthen controls, streamline processes, and maintain delivery momentum throughout a six-month fixed-term engagement, with a clear and structured handover at its close.

In this role as the Interim Senior Operational Finance Manager, you will...🚄

  • Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary operational finance team across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Finance Systems, and Cashbook, setting clear objectives, managing team capacity, and actively supporting the professional growth of every team member.

  • Own the day-to-day management of the AP and AR functions, ensuring invoices, payments, collections, and reconciliations are processed accurately, on time, and in line with strong governance and compliance standards.

  • Drive working capital performance by monitoring AP and AR KPIs, proactively managing aged debt and debtor days, and delivering regular reporting and insight to the Group Financial Controller.

  • Oversee bank and cash reconciliation across all entities and currencies, maintaining robust controls over cash processes including payment authorisation, segregation of duties, and reconciliation review.

  • Act as business owner for Trainline's core finance systems, ensuring platforms are scalable, secure, and well-governed, and that teams are empowered to use them effectively through training and change management.

  • Own the operational finance contribution to month-end close, ensuring ledgers are closed accurately and on time, and serve as a key point of contact throughout internal and external audit processes.

  • Identify and deliver process improvements with a focus on automation, efficiency, and scalability, coordinating with the Senior Finance Manager - Transformation to ensure changes are aligned with the broader Finance transformation roadmap.

  • Build trusted relationships across Finance, Technology, and the wider business, acting as the senior point of contact for operational finance and managing SLAs with internal stakeholders.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Substantial experience managing operational finance functions, ideally spanning Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and finance systems in a fast-paced commercial environment.

  • A strong track record of leading and developing high-performing finance teams, with the ability to set direction, manage performance, and support the professional growth of team members.

  • Solid expertise across AP/AR processes, credit control, working capital management, and financial controls, with a high standard of attention to detail and data governance.

  • Experience working within an ERP environment, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 or a comparable platform, with a confident grasp of transactional finance processes end-to-end.

  • A process improvement mindset, with demonstrated success delivering automation and efficiency gains across operational finance functions.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with stakeholders across Finance, Technology, and senior business leadership.

  • Confidence managing SLAs and service expectations with internal stakeholders, alongside the resilience to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  • Availability at short notice and comfort operating in an interim capacity, with the drive to take ownership quickly, deliver impact within a defined timeframe, and lead a clear and structured handover.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:
Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, 
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________

Locations Supported 🌍

  • London, UK

Relocation available: No

Work pattern: Hybrid: our teams meets in the office ~1-2 days a week

About the Opportunity

Every transaction we process requires a real-time decision. Declining a legitimate transaction leaves a customer stuck at the point of purchase, while approving a fraudulent one carries a direct cost.

This role owns the decisioning system and underlying platform. From the serving path and feature infrastructure to the underlying models and the machinery required to make safe, live updates. You will continuously improve the platform and our day to day workflows, rather than treating these as secondary projects.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will be part of a team that builds, ships, and maintains the entire machine learning lifecycle.

Our main focus is fraud detection and prevention, an adversarial domain where opponents constantly adapt and feedback arrives in the form of financial impact. Alongside, this we build broader capabilities to enable machine learning across Moonpay.

Lead through ambiguity

  • Turn vague problems into well-defined solutions and bring people with you.

  • Set the technical bar through rigorous reviews, clear standards, and lasting engineering habits.

Build and scale the platform

  • Develop feature infrastructure across batch, near-real-time, and in-request paths, managing specific freshness budgets for each.

  • Maintain alignment between training and serving to ensure models behave in production exactly as they did offline.

  • Integrate feedback loops to capture every decision and its outcome, including blocked transactions where results are counterfactual.

  • Scale the platform as volume and model complexity grow, ensuring operational load remains manageable.

Decide in real time

  • Own the services that score transactions in-flight, inside a hard latency budget

  • Design the degraded paths: what we answer when the model can't, and who agreed that policy

Ship safely, continuously

  • Mature the replay, shadow and staged-rollout tooling until changing a live model is routine and reversible

  • Own models across their lifecycle, from training through to retirement, and catch decay long before losses confirm it

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • Real-time serving. You have built and operated high-availability services that execute within strict latency budgets on critical paths, and you’ve designed robust fallback mechanisms

  • Systems thinking. You view the architecture holistically: identifying failure points, managing graceful degradation, and ensuring the system remains responsive even when dependencies fail. You build the feedback loops that allow a system to learn from its own decisions.

  • Engineering craft. You write code other people are happy to inherit — tested, typed, and correct when events arrive twice, late, or out of order. Adding the next feature to something you built is fast and painless.

  • Pipelines in production. You have owned feature or data pipelines end-to-end, including troubleshooting cases where offline and production metrics diverged and resolving the underlying discrepancies.

description:

About the role

As an Applied Research Engineer in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation.

You will join a highly focused team working at the intersection of large-scale generative modeling, distributed systems, and production engineering. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.

This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.

You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.

What you’ll do

You will own and execute end-to-end research and engineering projects, from hypothesis to production impact. This includes:

  • Developing and scaling latent video diffusion models tailored for human-centric video generation

  • Designing conditioning mechanisms to improve control (pose, emotion, script, camera) without sacrificing fidelity

  • Advancing distributed training strategies (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, sequence parallelism) under real compute constraints

  • Improving training stability at multi-node scale

  • Designing rigorous evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics and structured human evaluation

  • Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency

  • Running controlled ablations and experiments to drive high-signal modeling decisions

  • Contributing to high engineering standards: reproducibility, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring

You will be expected to move fast, run multiple hypotheses in parallel, identify signal early, and focus on outcomes rather than exploration for its own sake.

What we’re looking for


Must-have

  • Strong experience training deep learning models at scale

  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills

  • Hands-on experience with diffusion models (image domain required; video preferred)

  • Experience with large scale multi-GPU / multi-node training

  • Good understanding of distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed or similar)

  • Ability to design controlled experiments and interpret noisy results

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with video diffusion models

  • Experience in avatar or human-centric generation

  • Familiarity with world / interactive models

  • Experience with GANs or VAEs

Experience optimizing inference systems for production

Our stack

  • Python, PyTorch, CUDA

  • DeepSpeed, distributed training & inference

  • Sequence parallelism

  • AWS, SLURM, Docker

  • GitHub, CI/CD pipelines

Who you are

  • You are research-driven but outcome-focused

  • You care about shipping, not just publishing

  • You can explore multiple ideas quickly and drop low-signal directions early

  • You communicate clearly and present results scientifically

  • You operate independently but collaborate actively across teams

Why join us?

  • Build production-scale video foundation models in a fast-growing Generative AI company

  • Work on human-centric video generation with real-world impact

  • Tackle hard problems in scaling, stability, and controllability

  • Influence the direction of next-generation synthetic human technology

  • Join a highly technical, high-ownership environment where your work ships

If you want to work on cutting-edge generative video models and see your research power real-world products, we’d love to talk.

title: Full-stack Engineer - Operations Engineering Team
description:
Full-stack Engineer - Operations Engineering Team

Hybrid in London

We’re looking for a Full-stack Engineer to build the systems that power iwoca’s German business.

You’ll join the Operations Engineering team, a cross-functional group that builds the proprietary tools (like our CRM) that our German operations staff use every day. You’ll own high-impact projects from the ground up, using your technical experience and curious mindset to improve how we serve small businesses while also helping to level up the wider engineering team.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Operations Engineering team is a cross-functional group consisting of three full-stack engineers and one product manager. The team works closely with the Operations, Operations Strategy and Analytics teams to deliver impactful changes across the wider Operations function. The team builds and maintains the internal systems – including tools for underwriting, notifications, and account management – that power iwoca’s German market. They support more than 70 colleagues across sales, credit, and collections who rely on these tools every day.

As the German business grows, the Operations Engineering team is moving beyond small improvements and into reworking how work is done. By reducing manual steps and improving how information flows through the company, the team directly influences how quickly other teams can act, how reliably iwoca can support its customers, and where we can most effectively spend human effort.

The role

You’ll work on the systems that internal teams rely on to serve customers. You’ll take an initial problem, engage with stakeholders, and develop solutions through to delivery and see the outcome in daily use. You’ll design and build full-stack services that support core operational workflows, including customer communication, underwriting, and collections.

  • Simplify workflows: You’ll decide when and what to automate, translating operational needs into reliable code that reduces manual effort.

  • Evolve the architecture: You’ll identify ways to modernise our systems, managing trade-offs to keep them dependable as they scale.

  • Advocate for quality: You’ll be a key part of the team, using code reviews and design sessions to advocate for better engineering practices and staff user experiences.

  • Expand your scope: You’ll join a growing team that supports individual ownership, offering you opportunities to lead projects end-to-end, developing your commercial judgement.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Proven track record designing and building backend systems using Python, with the ability to work across front-end codebases, particularly React or TypeScript, to deliver projects end to end.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow—whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL or similar, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Able to use lateral thinking to anticipate technical challenges and to improve existing systems that support complex workflows.

  • A track record of taking work from an initial problem through to delivery, including shaping solutions, making trade-offs, and iterating based on how systems are used.

  • Strong communication skills to be able to explain complex technical topics in simple terms and to articulate and influence decision making within the team.

Bonus:

  • Knowing how to scale systems: Familiarity with working on internal tools or platforms used by large operational teams.

  • Framework experience across Python and TypeScript such as Django, FastAPI and React.

  • Modern deployment experience: Working with CI/CD pipelines or deployment workflows.

  • A data-driven mindset: Using data or metrics to assess whether changes have had the intended effect.

The salary

We expect to pay from £75,000–£90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Senior Manager, Regulatory Inspections and Strategic Response
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role


This is a newly created role sitting at the centre of some of Checkout.com's most sensitive and consequential regulatory moments. Reporting to the Director of External Affairs, the Senior Manager, Regulatory Inspections and Strategic Response will manage Checkout's most important regulatory situations end-to-end, whether planned or unplanned.

In practice, that means two connected mandates. The first is the planned, cyclical work of running Checkout's regulatory inspections and examinations — a methodical, deadline-driven discipline that forms the steady-state core of the role. The second is the unplanned work: leading the response to the exceptional, time-critical and commercially sensitive situations that require a calm cross-functional leader to bring them to a resolution.

You will be the person the business turns to when a regulator opens an inspection, and when a sensitive cross-functional situation needs to be stabilised quickly and handled with judgement. You will bring order and momentum to ambiguous, high-stakes matters, coordinating across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Commercial, Product, Tech and Communications, and you will own the strategy and the outcome.

This is a role with a clear mandate to build. You will establish the function, set the operating model, and over the course of 2027 hire and develop a small team of specialists to scale it.

What you'll do

Own regulatory inspections end-to-end

  • Act as the single accountable owner for Checkout's regulatory inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews across the group's regulated entities.

  • Run each inspection as a programme: set the strategy and narrative, build and manage the timeline, coordinate evidence gathering, quality-assure submissions, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior stakeholders for regulator engagement.

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination between the business and the regulator.

  • Protect the company's position throughout — controlling disclosures to what is necessary and appropriate, safeguarding confidential supervisory information, and ensuring the executive team and boards are informed at the right moments.

  • Drive continuous improvement by running post-mortems after each engagement and acting on any findings.

Lead the response to sensitive, escalated situations

  • Lead the response to the exceptional, time-critical situations that carry material regulatory, financial or reputation risk and need to be handled at pace.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: establish the facts, set out the risk and the options for senior decision-makers, secure decisions, assign actions, and maintain momentum until matters are resolved.

  • Work in close partnership with the Director of External Affairs on the most sensitive matters, acting as a trusted extension of the role.

Build the function

  • Establish the operating model and playbooks for a new function within Checkout.com

  • Hire, develop and lead a small team

What we are looking for

  • Significant experience in managing regulatory inspections and engagement - ideally within payments or fintech

  • A methodical, meticulous approach to project management

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure

  • Highly responsive, solutions-oriented and comfortable operating with ambiguity

  • Commercially pragmatic, with the ability to weigh regulatory and reputational risk against business objectives and to take considered, well-reasoned decisions

  • Excellent stakeholder management: credible with regulators and auditors, trusted by executives, and effective at mobilising colleagues across functions and geographies.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

  • Impeccable written communication

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
